name: com.bulkemailvalidation/email-verification-deliverability-mcp
title: BulkEmailValidation — Real-Time SMTP, MX & Catch-All Check MCP
description: Real-time email verification API for SMTP inbox check, MX, catch-all, disposable, and role filter.

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Validate a single email address in sub-80ms with zero SMTP probing: checks RFC-5322 syntax & punycode, live DNS-over-HTTPS MX/SPF/DMARC records, mail provider classification (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast), 121,900+ disposable/burner domains, role-based inboxes, Levenshtein typo correction (did_you_mean), corporate vs free-webmail flag, and live RDAP domain creation age. Cost: 2 Credits / email ($0.15/1K on Starter, $0.08/1K Business).

tools.name: validate_emails_bulk
tools.description: Validate up to 100 email addresses in a single high-speed batch with parallel domain DNS/RDAP deduplication. Returns batch summary metrics (valid, invalid, disposable, risky_role, corporate_count, avg_quality_score) plus full per-email verdicts. Cost: 2 Credits / email validated.

items.description: Single email address in the batch.

emails.description: Array of 1–100 email addresses to validate in a single call.

tools.name: check_disposable_and_role_email
tools.description: Ultra-fast sub-10ms filter checking an email or domain against 121,900+ disposable/burner email domains, wildcard traps, role-based inboxes (admin@, support@, noreply@, billing@), free webmail vs corporate domain classification, and common typo suggestions. Cost: 1 Credit / call.

domain.description: Optional domain name to check directly if full email is omitted.

tools.name: audit_domain_deliverability
tools.description: Run a complete outbound & inbound email authentication audit for any domain: MX records & mail provider, SPF record validity & DNS lookup budget, DMARC enforcement policy (none/quarantine/reject), BIMI/MTA-STS/TLS-RPT readiness, RDAP domain age & registrar, deliverability grade (A+–F), and actionable remediation recommendations. Cost: 5 Credits / domain.
